title: Review the Object Selection / Shadow / UI plan made 1–2h ago
summary: The recent plan is docs/OBJECT_SELECTION_SHADOW_UI_PLAN.md (plus a - Copy variant and related .buzzcode/plans files). It is explicitly "planning only" and records that prior partial implementations were interrupted, so its first directive is to re-inspect the current diff and establish a per-area baseline before implementing anything. This plan verifies what state each of the four areas is actually in right now.

steps.description: Read docs/OBJECT_SELECTION_SHADOW_UI_PLAN.md in full (633 lines) and diff it against 'OBJECT_SELECTION_SHADOW_UI_PLAN - Copy.md' to see which revision is current.
steps.verification: Confirm the two files differ only in review-correction revisions; identify the newer one.

steps.description: Cross-check the plan's 'Changes already present' table against the live working tree (git diff --stat on buzz-app/src/tools.rs, buzz-scene shadow/modifier files, buzz-ui panels) to classify each area as verified/incomplete/unverified.
steps.verification: git diff --stat shows which areas still have uncommitted changes; note that the whole tree is dirty, so rely on per-file inspection.

steps.description: Run the relevant existing test suites to establish a baseline (selection/free-transform, shadow, panel layout tests).
steps.verification: cargo test -p buzz-app --test rigging_panel and cargo test -p buzz-ui pass/fail results recorded as the pre-implementation baseline.

steps.description: Report a concise status summary per plan area (selection transform, shadows, right-side UI, Adobe import fidelity) with what is done vs. remaining, so the user can decide whether to authorize implementation.
steps.verification: User receives the status report; no code changes made.

risks: The working tree has ~150 modified files from interrupted work; attributing changes per plan area is ambiguous.
A '- Copy' duplicate of the plan exists — unclear which revision is authoritative.
questions: Did you mean the OBJECT_SELECTION_SHADOW_UI_PLAN.md plan (or one of the .buzzcode/plans/* free-transform plans)?
Do you want a read-only status review, or should I proceed to implement part of it?
